sql: WITH bounds AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM public.moi_real_price_transactions WHERE id>13607 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1000), old_ids AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT v.id FROM public.moi_preview_transactions v JOIN bounds b USING(id)), new_ids AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT t.id FROM public.moi_real_price_transactions t JOIN bounds b USING(id) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.moi_real_price_transactions c WHERE t.source_record_key LIKE 'moi:%' AND c.source_record_key=substring(t.source_record_key FROM 5)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.moi_real_price_transactions c WHERE t.source_record_key LIKE 'moi:a:n:%' AND c.source_record_key=replace(t.source_record_key,'moi:a:n:','n:a:') AND c.dataset_type IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.dataset_type AND c.county IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.county AND c.district IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.district AND c.transaction_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.transaction_date AND c.total_price_ntd IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.total_price_ntd AND c.land_area_sqm IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.land_area_sqm AND c.building_area_sqm IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.building_area_sqm)), dif AS ((SELECT id FROM old_ids EXCEPT SELECT id FROM new_ids) UNION ALL (SELECT id FROM new_ids EXCEPT SELECT id FROM old_ids)) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM bounds) sampled, (SELECT max(id) FROM bounds) last_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM old_ids) old_count,(SELECT count(*) FROM new_ids) new_count,(SELECT count(*) FROM dif) differences;
